review_comments.body:
Possible alternative:

```suggestion
theorem round_pi_eq_three : round π = 3 :=
  round_eq _ |>.trans <| Int.floor_eq_iff.mpr ⟨by grind [pi_gt_three], by grind [pi_lt_d2]⟩
```

I don't have a strong preference. But would this be a middle ground?
```suggestion
theorem floor_pi_eq_three : ⌊π⌋ = 3 := by
  rw [Int.floor_eq_iff]
  grind [pi_gt_three, pi_lt_four]
```

We can also
```suggestion
theorem floor_pi_eq_three : ⌊π⌋ = 3 :=
  Int.floor_eq_iff.mpr ⟨pi_gt_three.le, by exact_mod_cast pi_lt_four⟩
```
